Consequently, the deferred tax liability recognised by the Company on fair value gains on its investments as on September 30, 2024 has increased by Rs. 12.10 crore thereby resulting in an additional  tax charge on the profit after tax of the Company for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2024.      8.
